components.description: Finds one Excel row using a pandas query, then updates it or appends a new row. Without Write Data, returns the first match.

inputs.info: Optional query variables supplied as a JSON/Data object. A has_<key> boolean is generated for each key.

inputs.info: Optional pandas DataFrame query. Use @variable_name for values supplied through Dynamic Variables. When Write Data is supplied and this field is empty, a new row is appended.

inputs.name: sheet_name
inputs.info: Worksheet name. Leave empty to use the first worksheet.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.info: Maximum time to wait for another process to release the workbook lock.

inputs.name: write_data
inputs.info: Optional JSON/Data object used to update the first matching row or append a new row. Leave empty for read-only search mode.

components.description: Validates Meta X-Hub-Signature-256 using the App Secret and the exact Universal Webhook raw_body. Returns one JSON object containing the verification result, verified payload, original request data, response definition, and any error.

inputs.name: app_secret
inputs.info: The App Secret from the Meta app that owns this webhook. It is used as the HMAC-SHA256 key and is never included in the output.

inputs.name: request_data
inputs.info: Connect the complete JSON output from Universal Webhook. The component reads headers, raw_body, body, and method from the request envelope. Do not pass only the parsed body.

components.description: Validates Meta webhook verification requests for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook. Connect its Response Definition output to Webhook Response.

inputs.name: request_data
inputs.info: Connect the JSON output from Universal Webhook. The component reads hub.mode, hub.verify_token, and hub.challenge from request_data.query.

inputs.name: verify_token
inputs.info: The verification token configured by you in the Meta webhook settings. It must exactly match hub.verify_token sent by Meta.
